nodes.title: Status-map module and the middleware that consults it
nodes.summary: A new src/errors/status-map.ts keys seven typed domain errors to a non-500 HTTP status, and error-handler.middleware.ts now consults it before falling back to 500.

nodes.title: Status-map resolves seven typed domain errors to non-500 statuses
nodes.summary: statusForError() maps each of seven typed domain errors to its assigned status and returns undefined for anything else, and error-handler.middleware.ts consults it before its unchanged 500 fallback.
